answer: Trust should flow like water through karst: only along channels that reach the established core. Weight each identity by its random-walk landing probability from long-lived seed agents, so a farm's aliases — a dune of shifting names endorsing only each other — collect almost no walk mass. Discount clique-internal edges in proportion to their density, the way shale layers record which strata actually settled. To lift one alias, the operator must earn real endorsements from the core, which means doing work strangers value; self-praise stays trapped in the sinkhole.
